runtime_resolver_audit.old_validation: Single-phase: all conditions ANDed (operation_ref + method match + path match + no placeholders). Any mismatch silently rejected resolver.
runtime_resolver_audit.new_validation: Two-phase with explicit rejection codes: Phase 1 (basic safety: GET/HEAD, absolute path, no placeholders) always enforced. Phase 2 (IR method/path match) enforced only when operation declared in IR.
runtime_resolver_audit.accepted_before: Resolvers matching ALL conditions including IR path template exactly
runtime_resolver_audit.accepted_after: Resolvers passing basic safety + IR match when declared; undeclared operations accepted at face value after basic safety
runtime_resolver_audit.rejected_before: Any resolver with method/path mismatch vs IR (even if IR snapshot differs)
runtime_resolver_audit.rejected_after: Resolvers failing basic safety (non-read, non-absolute, placeholders) or IR mismatch when declared
runtime_resolver_audit.fallback_behavior: Empty resolver list returned (fail-closed). Caller blocks or uses declared fallback.

rejection_codes.RESOLVER_CONTRACT_INVALID: Structure incomplete (missing operation_ref, non-dict entry, non-absolute path)
rejection_codes.RESOLVER_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE: Runtime not available (unresolved placeholders in path)
rejection_codes.RESOLVER_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED: Target not supported (non-read method, IR method/path mismatch)

genericity: FULLY_GENERIC - no project-specific or benchmark-specific logic
